title: This GIANT Electric Semi Can Swap Out Its Batteries!
summary: Fully Charged visits Janus Trucks in New South Wales, Australia, which converts diesel trucks to electric with swappable battery packs. The truck carries 620 kWh of batteries and a 540 kW drive.
why: HN points to it as a real example of battery swapping and diesel-to-electric conversion for heavy trucks.

quote.text: there's a small Aussie company that seems to be doing quite well with electric truck conversions
